sources.snippet: Qwen3Guard is a series of safety moderation models built upon Qwen3 and trained on a dataset of 1.19 million prompts and responses labeled for safety. The series includes models of three sizes (0.6B, 4B, and 8B) and features two specialized variants: Qwen3Guard-Gen, a generative model that accepts full user prompts and model responses to perform safety classification, and Qwen3Guard-Stream ...
